about_the_game:
Vita: The Ember Oracle

Description:

Return to Atria, where the Great City of Pando has been thrust into chaos. Religious ideology runs rampant, fueled by the terrifying prophecy of The Ember Oracle, a Vita believed to herald Pando's very destruction.

Join Sin-Nul, a Vita caught between fate and the radical ideas spread by the Ever Flame of Pando. His journey through the city's sprawling, chaotic districts will plunge him into a desperate struggle for truth and survival.

Unleash a new Battle System:

Learn new Skills: Learn and master an array of new skills through the Skill Learn System and equip them with the new Skill Slot System. Each new skill demands thoughtful selection to outwit your foes.

Dynamic Party Swapping: Adapt on the fly with always-present party members, allowing for seamless in-battle swaps to counter any threat.

Explore a World Reborn:

Pando: Traverse four (4) unique regions within the city of Pando, each inspired by distinct Late Middle Age European cultures.

Updated Visuals: Experience the world of Atria like never before, with updated graphics that breathe new life into every environment.

Realized Character Portraits: Connect deeply with your cast through beautifully rendered character portraits.

A Story of Profound Discovery:

Beyond the battlefield, The Ember Oracle delivers a rich narrative steeped in themes of self-discovery and the abuse of people's beliefs for control. Unravel a tale that challenges perceptions and reveals the true cost of power.

Ignite your inner flame in Vita: The Ember Oracle. The third story of the epic the Vita saga.

content_descriptors.notes: This game explores themes of religion and faith. Its story is crafted not to promote or discredit any particular belief, but to foster understanding and empathy between different perspectives.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-4340 or better
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Compatible OpenGL/CRAM 1gb or better
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: 1280x720 display or better
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 5600 or better
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD Radeon 580 or Better
  • Storage: 7 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: 1280x720 display or better

short_description: Dive into Vita: The Ember Oracle, where the city of Pando is torn by zealous dogma and a terrifying prophecy. Follow Sin-Nul's story of self-discovery and understanding of beliefs, as he fights to unravel a conspiracy threatening to destroy the Ever Flame.
